output.summary: A tall, grain-bearing perennial tropical grass native to Southeast Asia. Its wild variety has very hard, pearly white oval cases used as beads, while cultivated variety ma-yuen has soft shells and is harvested as a cereal. Across East Asia, dried grains are cooked and widely eaten, especially in gruels.
output.edibilityNote: Dried grains, especially from soft-shelled cultivated varieties, are cooked across East Asia as cereal or gruel.
